technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum (RSI overbought, AO cross-up, three white soldiers) conflicts with intermediate bearish structure (price below 200-MA, bearish 20/50 MA alignment); suitable for tactical swing entry with tight stops, not strategic position.

fundamental.summary: FIS shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 14 days—fundamentals are neutral to weak with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity with no directional signal; broad market fear (37/100) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (339.2), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinational earnings, with earnings event in 14 days compounding volatility risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term momentum (RSI overbought + rising, AO cross-up, three white soldiers) with price near support (87.58) offers tactical swing entry with defined risk in fear-zone market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising dollar), high earnings risk in 14 days, price below both 200-MA and 50-SMA, weak fundamentals, and low volume (0.75 ratio) make this a high-risk, low-conviction setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (RSI overbought, AO cross-up, three white soldiers) offers tactical appeal at support, but severe macro headwinds and high earnings risk in 14 days make risk/reward unfavorable for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis environment combined with earnings event in 14 days creates binary event risk; price below 200-MA and weak volume (0.75 ratio) suggest momentum may not sustain through earnings.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents see entry opportunity, but fundamental, sentiment, and risk agents strongly oppose due to macro environment and earnings proximity.
decision.portfolio_note: Already 22 positions in Information Technology sector; adding FIS increases concentration risk in high-volatility sector during crisis VIX environment.
